resources.string: Pick a level. You review every change before anything happens.
Every level is a starting point: on the next screen you tell Prune which manufacturer and Google features you use, and untick anything you want to keep.
Packages behind the features you keep ticked are never selected. Untick what you never use.
YouTube, Google TV, Meet, Gemini, Google One... Google Play Services is always kept.
Apps you haven\'t opened for 30 days: %1$d.

Custom mode lists every package Prune allows you to change, including high-risk ones. Protected packages (telephony, System UI, security, biometrics, core Android) are not listed and cannot be selected.
Nothing selected. Everything at this level is already off, or kept by your answers above.
